Can cards stolen by Agitas's ability be traded with Succubus Club?
Do they physically go into the target player's hand, or do they
stay down on the table?

The image of selling your prey's library for pool (and, of course,
other cards-from-hand to preserve hand size as per SC text) is an
amusing concept.. :)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> Can cards stolen by Agitas's ability be traded with Succubus Club?
> Do they physically go into the target player's hand, or do they
> stay down on the table?

They can be traded.
The card Agaitas allowed you to draw remains face-up in the new hand.
The card you traded for remains "in-hand" in you hand.

> If that is possible, and the card gets given back to its original
> owner (i.e. 'holding his cards for ransom'), does it go back into his
> hand?

No, it would still remain face-up until played or discarded.
